# SKMemory

> Per-agent memory for the SK stack. Flat JSON files are the source of truth, with a SQLite index, a pgvector vector backend and an Apache AGE graph backend.

SKMemory stores memory per agent in short-term, mid-term and long-term directories of JSON files,
synced between nodes by Syncthing. A local SQLite index is rebuilt from those files. Vectors
(PGVectorBackend, dimension 1024, mxbai-embed-large via ordered Ollama endpoints) and the graph
(AGEGraphBackend) live in one Postgres (skmem-pg). A node is healthy only when all three backends
report ok. Agents use it through an MCP server (memory_store, memory_search, memory_recall,
memory_list, memory_context, memory_health and more) or the skmemory CLI.
